acceptanceCriteria: A behaviour-preserving contextindex edit needs no manual schema/SHA/receipt edits, or one command performs all three; measured on a sample fix.
body: Observed across the 2026-10-20 impact-index bug lane: 7 small contextindex fixes needed schema 131 bump, analyzer SHA pin edits and script/repin-use-case-receipts.sh runs, roughly a third of the lane's verification time. Related V1-1732 (concurrent schema bumps collide). Expected: only changes that alter emitted index content bump the schema; pins derive mechanically.

completion.reason: Delivered on main c9ca8beff43d8f548b054d3b3d40e3054cecf816 via batch beamfall/corvint#1399 (lane #1396); CI green on that commit (runs 39571877340). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 adcaac2c1ed77e42b69731e8e1fc9bb7e4f69f5d729f477483add3d24fa9a7a8.

title: Every contextindex edit forces an analyzer schema bump, SHA pin update and use-case receipt repin
